追記:ガチで有り得ないです。今まで勉強の記録として書いていたことがタイトルとして表示されなくなっていちいち開かないと確認できなくなっている。アプデ以降タイトルと内容で分けられるようになったのはまあ100歩譲っていいですが、それまでタイトルとして表示されていたものが表示されなくなるのはアカンでしょう。もはや使用をやめるか迷うレベルです。

さらに追記:タイマーを使おうとしたら45分と設定したはずなのに30分で終了するというようなことが頻発しているんだがどうなってるんだ？何でUI変えたの？それまでは全く1ミリも不満がなかったのに。何で変えたの？暴言が出そうになるレベル。マジで意味がわからん。やることなすこと全部改悪て。開発者たちは実際に使用感を試しているのか？

reviews.title: Update hat Nutzung massiv verschlechtert
reviews.text: Für eine Zeiterfassungs-App ist diese Funktion ein absoluter Vollpfosten-Einfall: Nach jedem Tracking muss ich mich erst durch mehrere Screens klicken, nur wegen irgendwelcher gesammelten Punkte und Belohnungen. Statt den Fokus auf die eigentliche Tätigkeit zu lassen, nimmt die App nun massiv mehr Raum ein. Seitdem habe ich Dutzende Male in den Einstellungen versucht, diesen ganzen Mist abzuschalten, leider ohne Erfolg. Meine Nutzung hat damit ein Ablaufdatum. Ein gutes Beispiel für Verschlimmbesserung. Empfehlung: Nach Beendigung einer Fokus Zeit kommt man aktuell zwingend auf 3 völlig überflüssige Screens, die deaktiviert werden sollten oder deaktivierbar sein sollten, da sie derzeit den Zweck der App, seine Zeit sinnvoll zu nutzen, völlig konterkarieren: „Belohnung einlösen“ >> „Belohnung eingelöst“ >> „Notiz verfassen“. Außerdem sollte die Animation überdacht und fade Mechanismen beschleunigt werden, auch sie geben einem das Gefühl mit der Nutzung der App seine wertvolle Zeit zu verschwenden

reviews.title: Became too profit driven, deleting the app
reviews.text:
Once an app gets too big, the app starts to lose focus of the app’s main purpose. That’s what happened to Forest. 

It used to be so straight forward, which is just to track your study time and you get a digital tree in your forest for studying. Now, it’s all about trying to make you buy coins, pop ups after pop ups, and trying to get you to get this type of tree and plant. It’s so silly to me. Do they not know the demographics of their users? 

Are people really paying for “coins”? And for what? JUST focus on studying and passing your class/exams. 

The last straw for me was the app removing the total focus  time of the day on the main screen. what?? That’s literally the whole point of a study app…. To track your total time spent studying. 

I know they see their growing user base and now all they think about is how to extract money from each of them. It’s literally just a study app.. what kind of big money do y’all really think you will eventually make? 

Farewell. I’ll be using another study app from now on.

reviews.text:
I first downloaded this app about 6 years ago and used it with a friend. We both loved it; it was a simple way to keep us both off our phones and on task. Each of us even bought a subscription. 

These past few months, the UI updates and AI integration have made this app so, so clunky. It breaks my heart to say that it's an eyesore now. The designs feel so much less simple and human-made. Clicking through a series of prompts makes the planting feature less efficient to use. 

Please, please offer some settings to help us go back to the way things were. Cut the AI garbage and cumbersome UI. For an app that espouses the value of getting off screen and going out into the world to do good (planting trees irl, getting your work done and be a functioning person), the AI integration is such a big disappointment. 

I've been actively searching for better apps to use. Please Forest, listen to those of us posting here and online.

Under the most recent update they removed the ability to configure “favourites” which were easy to pick combinations of tags and trees, completely gutting my use of the app and violating their promise of retaining pro features that users paid for.

Do not trust this company, do not download this app. It will demand your attention and focus on your screen, it will not help you focus on other things. It’s a shame as it was a great app for many years.

Früher (um 2017) perfekt jetzt überfrachtet, verwirrend und funktioniert nicht mehr. 




Früher hatte es tatsächlich Konsequenzen, wenn man die App verlassen hat. Jetzt ist die App nicht mehr alleine Hübsche Eieruhr. 

Schade, bei anderen Apps funktioniert das. 



So schade, was aus der App geworden ist. Sie war so so toll - App öffnen, Zeit wie bei einem Zahnrad einstellen (was ein bisschen Spaß gemacht hat) und Baum pflanzen - fertig. Super reduziert und minimalistisch. 

Nichts wurde blockiert - was super ist, weil man dann nicht ständig die Liste überprüfen muss, da manche Apps in die falsche Liste rutschen ODER man z.B.  aus beruflichen Gründen Instagram nutzen will. Man musste sich nicht durch tausend Einstellungen tippen, bis man endlich den Baum pflanzt. 

Alles ist unübersichtlich und zu viel geworden. 

Und das schlimmste: es gibt die Hauptfunktion nicht mehr. Der Baum stirbt gar nicht mehr, wenn man die App verlässt. So ist die App nicht mehr als ein ästhetischer Wecker. Man könnte morgens einen Baum für 24 Stunden stellen, und sein Handy ganz normal weiter nutzen. 

Aber das war doch das besondere an Forest: es wurde nichts blockiert (was ich auch gar nicht will), aber es hat den eigenen Willen unterstützt. Man will ja nicht, dass der schöne Baum stirbt 🥹 


Aber so ist die Idee der App einfach sinnlos. Schade!

reviews.title: New UI Has Some Pros, But I Haaaaate the Popups
reviews.text:
They changed the user interface today. 

What I like:
- The new “my plants” section makes it easier to see trees.
- It’s easier to pick a tag.

What I don’t like:
- Annoying popups flash across my screen when I finish planting a tree and want to back to the home screen! This app is supposed to reduce distractions, not create them. 
- Some of the trees displayed are not purchasable in the store, yet clicking on them still takes me to the store. 
- There are still very few tag colors. Other people and I specifically submitted a feedback request asking for more tag colors, but there are still just a handful. 

What I feel mixed about:
- The trees bounce up and down, and the coin icon shimmers. It’s kind of cool, but also very distracting.



Edit; I changed my review to one star. They’re now deleting trees from the regular store and making you rebuy them for a much higher price only on certain days when they happen to appear in the temporary store that refreshes daily. This is so stupid. It’s clear that they’re creating a scarcity mindset to pressure people to check the app often. That goes against the whole point of making an app to get you off your phone!

広告はプロユーザーをひたすらイラ立たせて、サブスクに追い込みたいという目的があったとしても、今のバグが増える一方のアプデでは逆効果では。

reviews.title: Terrible new update
reviews.text: This used to be the only study app that worked for me! But now, they’ve totally changed the interface and betrayed their long term users (I have used this app for 3 years to track all my studying). I have to click so many times to plant a new tree now and I just don’t have the same focus using the app :( Before, the UI was simple, I liked the monthly challenges and the way I could see my focus time from the main screen, as well as toggling deep focus on and off easily. Now, they’ve added new features no one asked for and removed the ones we have been using for years! As well as making things a nightmare to click through and find… Forest devs, why did you ruin something good, please bring back your old user experience!!! I will be looking for alternative apps now.

reviews.title: New update makes it unusable
reviews.text:
I’ve used Forest since I was in University so over 10 years now. What I loved about it was the ease and efficiency, very simple to get it started and remove myself off my phone. 
Now with the new update it is fully gamified and almost defeats the point of using it. I do quite like the focus challenge aspect that was brought in a while ago but the new interface is terrible. Previously all on one screen you could choose the tag and timer, you’d only need to go into a new screen for the tree. Now it’s one click to open a screen for the tag, come off that, open another screen for the timer which only has the slider option now not the most used times as a button.
Once focusing is done you have to click 3 times to come out of the screen which focuses on the coins won and tells you the same info multiple times on different screens. Then do the process all over again. It takes too long and has removed any kind of USP this app had over others. 
Also on the focus challenge you open it up and the first things you see is the plus challenge and the special event for planting with friends - neither of which I do. You have to then scroll down for the normal ones. It’s clear what they’re trying to push here

reviews.title: Update is horrible
reviews.text:
Loved the app, have been a user for 5+ years, but this new update made using Forest extremely difficult, annoying and frustrating. The new interface is too complicated and not being able to see the day’s total concentration time erases the whole point of tracking productivity during a work day for me (and many others). Having to click through multiple slow (!) steps to reach the home interface after a study session isn’t only annoyingly slow working, but also resulted in me tapping my phone angrily and therefore suddenly “loosing” a tree and a session log because the app was too slow to register the session being completed but rather saved it as a “failed session” since it more than once made me accidentally click on “back home” instead of “end session”. 
Using Forest became way less enjoyable and irritating. If you’re not going to change back to an easier and less complicated interface I’ll be using a different tracking and Pomodoro app. Which would be incredibly sad.

reviews.title: It’s was great
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app since 2022 and have found it fantastic for helping us make the most of our time during the day… until now. Since the last update, which changed the graphic and layout of the trees (I even appreciate this new refresh in the app), it has stopped saving all my data from the app to HealthKit. In fact, since September 8th after the update, it stopped syncing, and now I don’t have any record in my Mindful Minutes tab on the Apple Health app. It even changed my trend this week and was where I saw this issue. I tried to contact support and informed them that everything that has to be on is on and even uninstalled and reinstalled the app several times. I also noticed that the last update (V5.26.0) makes the app run more slowly and with a lot of crashes… it can be a bit frustrating because in all four past years, this never happened, and now (I became a plus user too) it seems to be a huge issue that needs to be solved as soon as possible.

The old user interface was much better and friendlier to use - I wish it were reinstated! 

I wish all the new updates focused on fixing existing issues raised by the user community instead of arbitrary complete and radical refurbishes everyone unanimously resents. Thank you!

I have been using the app for several years as a Pro user, and unfortunately it slid towards gameified and addicting features. Specifically, Id prefer if it required less taps to access key features, allowed you to save your favourite tree+tag+planting time combinations (as it used to), was trimmed down in terms of rewards and schemes (eg a seasonal tree is nice, but I dont need 3 gift boxes and 3 coin boxes underneath it every day), and brought back custom onscreen phrases.

reviews.title: Downhill Slide
reviews.text: I’ve used this app since 2016 and have been a huge advocate for it since early days. While I can’t think of any period of time in the past decade where the Forest app has maintained excellent stability free of glitches, the overall usefulness of the app has allowed me to look past that. In the past 12-18 months, things have been going downhill. The devs keep pushing out excessive updates that prioritize gamification in the app and focus on money-making capacity of the app. All the while, stability in the app for users like myself and my friends has decreased and glitches have increased to the point of a non-functional app. Sharing session links, planting together, and Deep Focus mode are all useless now with the rollout of a new UI and the retirement of “classic” mode. It’s a real shame. I’ve accumulated over 275 days of planting time in this app, the majority of which were logged in Plant Together mode with friends. I’ll be sad to leave the app and my land of virtual trees behind, but it may be the natural course of things if the devs continue to ignore prioritization of the function and stability of the Forest app.

reviews.title: I love this app, but…
reviews.text:
I really love this app. I’ve been using it for years and have found it very helpful to focus and track my writing time. However, since the introduction of focus challenge I have been annoyed by the implementation. My biggest issue is the fact that I have to reset my focus timer each time I want to “plant a tree” for the challenge. If I do 2 hours in the app, it says I planted 4 trees in my forest but only one tree for the daily challenge. If the daily challenge says “plant any tree 4 times” I have to start and stop my focus timer four times (once every 30 minutes) in order for the trees to count. Why? The fact that I have to interrupt my focus time to stop and reset in order to achieve the daily challenge is ridiculous. It’s actually the opposite of focus, enough that I may have to switch to a different app because it is distracting me trying to keep my trees and focus time to match. 

Please fix this. Make it so that when I focus for a number of hours, the daily challenge counts my trees planted, not by the number of times I started focusing. It feels like a bug, but it’s been present since the focus challenge released. Thanks!

集中時間を調整する機能も初見じゃ分からなかったので、分かりにくい設計になっているなとも思います。

왜 바꿨어요. UI 진짜 별로입니다. 심기가 완료되면 화면에서 집중한 총 시간 보이게 놔둬야지 그 중요한 기능을 왜 굳이 없애요? 어플들이 대체로 업데이트 되면 항상 다운그레이드 되는 느낌이여서 자동업데이트 꺼놓도 살았는데 왜 업데이트된거야... 진짜 싫다

이전에는 시작 눌러놓고 잠금화면에서 정지(완료), 재시작 가능했으나 업데이트 된 후로 쓸데없이 3번의 클릭(정지-보상받기-휴식/홈으로가기)을 거쳐야만 하고, 현재까지의 집중시간을 보려면 업데이트 이전에는 메인화면 중앙 상단에 바로 떴었는데 이제는 메뉴에 들어가서 눌러야만 오늘의 총 집중시간을 확인할 수 있게됨.

잠금화면에서 재시작 못하게 하는것도 답답한게 어떻게든 어플에 들어가서 클릭 세번이나 눌러야 된다는게 제일 짜증남. 쓸데없는 기능들좀 전부 빼요. 도대체 왜 기본에 충실하지 않고 편리성과는 거리에 먼 잡다한 것만 챙기나요? 부스터로 보상받기, 광고보기로 보상 더 받기 등의 기능 생긴거보면 돈 벌려는게 느껴져서 시험 끝나고 나서는 절대 이용하지 않고 삭제할겁니다. 이 어플을 돈 주고 샀던 이유가 쓸데없는 게 없고 직관적이여서 좋았는데 이제는 어느 어플보다 손이 많이가고 불편해졌습니다. 롤백을 하든 선택권을 주든 해야 기존 유저 이탈도 없고 유입도 늘 거 같은데, 이대로라면 참 답이 없습니다.

reviews.title: Glitchy Interface and overcommercialization
reviews.text:
I’ve used the forest app for over a decade, and even purchased the paid version, in which time I’ve gotten tens of friends to join and have used it religiously throughout college, grad school applications, and entering the workforce. I loved this app. 

I’m incredibly disappointed in the direction the app has gone, pushing a bigger and more expensive paid option and updating the UI in a way that is glitchy, lags, and no longer tracks time accurately. When I focus longer than the set time, despite having my settings to track extended time, it doesn’t record it. The app also crashes at least once a week or takes 30s-1 min just to switch pages. I’m also sick of having Plus pushed onto me - I have already paid for Forest previously and don’t want my app to continue trying to sell me stuff. This is also not even to mention that I can no longer plant trees in real life or make any kind of real world impact. 

I will stop using Forest if the glitches and over commercialization do not get fixed.

Why change something if it’s not broke? At the very least give users an option to stick with the original format/design.

reviews.text: I bought Forest maybe two years ago at the recommendation of a friend. I think it’s a great tool for keeping me off my phone, especially when I need to focus on something or have short intervals of time away from my phone. But after redownloading it recently after a period of not using it, there are so many more in-app purchases that restrict the way the app is used and make it hard to incentivize using it. I liked Forest because it was a pay-once kind of app, and not subscription based the way most things are nowadays. But now in order to cultivate any sort of beautiful forest or garden on this app, you have to pay exorbitant amounts of money for fake trees and shrubs (any amount of money is exorbitant for fake trees and shrubs on an app i’ve already paid for 🙄). Unfortunately Forest has caved to the same sort of capitalist greed that every other app has. If anyone has any other productivity apps that work well and won’t cost me an arm and a leg please let me know!

reviews.title: Terrible now they’ve made it free
reviews.text: This used to be a really phenomenal app and perfect for studying as an undergraduate student. It used to be really helpful for focusing and also helped with motivation and planting more trees. However now they’re clearly trying to squeeze even more money out of users in the pursuit of further profit. I paid for this app rather than the many others that are free, because it explicitly did not have ads and all features would be accessible once you purchase it. Now however, they’ve shifted to making it free but with yet another subscription service meant to harass people into buying it. There’s now ads that make the app buggy, and constant efforts to try and get you to spend more on it. This is extremely frustrating and dishonest particularly to those of us who have paid to download it. At first they made us into a “pro” service with no ads but now they’ve introduced a “plus” group and have started to spam the pro group with ads to get them to purchase the plus and subscribe to yet another racketeering scheme. Absolutely disgraceful behaviour. Do not waste your money on this and go download one of the many other productivity apps where at the very least you know what you’re paying for.

I would not recommend paying to subscribe to this app. It was good when it was a one off payment and the original features were included in that price, but recently I’ve been really disappointed by the greed of the developers damaging the apps utility.

reviews.title: The support representative’s response was terrible
reviews.text:
After updating the app, I was automatically logged out. When I logged back in, almost all of my five years of data had disappeared, leaving only the records from the afternoon of the update day. It was practically a full reset.

Among the few records that remained, there were trees that I supposedly ‘no longer own’ after the reset, including the Dahlia, which was a reward from a focused challenge several months ago. This clearly proves that my account had existed and been active long before.

What is worse, when I contacted the support desk, they repeatedly told me, ‘Your email address was just registered yesterday. Please log in to the correct account.’

Even though I explained multiple times that the remaining records clearly show I had been using this account long before, and even though I sent them screenshots of emails previously delivered to this address to prove that this account had been active for a long time, they refused to acknowledge any of it. They kept insisting that I should ‘log in to the correct account.’ It was the worst support experience.

All the Time Crystals I had purchased also disappeared, and yet I received no proper assistance. I am extremely disappointed.

reviews.title: Taking away free features
reviews.text: I liked this app some time ago but they've become very money-hungry lately. Free features like custom tags have become subscription locked. Pathetic.
